When the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] struck a deal with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''resistance movement''' sprung up to oppose him. The resistance, led at least in part by the Khormai [[Adaroo]], joined forced with a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] force under the leadership of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to drive Gout and the Separatists from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].
